scripts.buildRust: cargo rustc --features webgpu  --lib --manifest-path ./Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -C target-feature=+simd128,+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals && cd ../buildscript && cargo run
scripts.buildRust-prod: cargo rustc --features webgpu --release --lib --manifest-path ./Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -C target-feature=+simd128,+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals && cd ../buildscript && cargo run --release
scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.debug.json && npm run buildWasmSimd && npm run buildRust && npm run build-webpack-debug
scripts.build-prod: tsc -b  && npm run buildWasmSimd-prod && npm run buildRust-prod && npm run build-webpack-prod
scripts.test: npm run test-unit && npm run test-integration && npm run test-wasm && npm run test-rust && npm run test-cypress
scripts.test-integration: npm run buildRust && start npm run swa && node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js  --forceExit --detectOpenHandles --runInBand --silent=false --config=jest.integration.config.js
scripts.test-rust: cargo test --lib --workspace --manifest-path ./Cargo.toml && cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli && cd terramath && cargo test --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.clean: pwsh -Command "rm *.tsbuildinfo; rm -r ./node_modules;rm -r ../wwwroot/js"; cargo clean; cargo clean --target-dir ../buildscript/target
